avis.titre: Amazing serum, give it time and you will see results and feel great!
avis.texte: This serum is pricey, BUT it is amazing for your skin. My skin has balanced out, smoothed out and fine lines have diminished. You have to GIVE IT TIME. People are too quick to say a product doesn't work because they don't see immediate results. I didn't start seeing results until well into my second bottle (2-3 months), but you will feel it as soon as you apply. Soft, nourished skin. Trust me, this one's a keeper! Worth every penny.
I’ve always liked this brand and the serum does provide extra hydration for my skin

avis.titre: Hydrating, Plumping and Gentle on Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: The texture is slightly thicker than some serums but absorbs beautifully into the skin without feeling sticky. It leaves my skin feeling instantly hydrated and noticeably plumper, especially around fine lines. The hyaluronic acid gives that smooth, bouncy look, and it layers well under moisturiser and makeup. I also appreciate that it’s gentle and suitable for sensitive skin — no irritation, redness or breakouts for me. Over time, my skin looks more refreshed and well-rested, with improved texture. It is on the pricier side for 30ml, but a small amount goes a long way. Overall, a high-quality serum that delivers on hydration and subtle anti-ageing benefits. I would definitely repurchase.
